source.title: Framer: Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex, Grok, and more to Framer
source.description: Use Framer with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex in ChatGPT, and other AI tools. Connect directly to build and update sites. No MCP setup required.
source.content:

> npx @framer/agent setup
⏺ Bash (npx @framer/agent setup)\ Installed 2 skills to /Users/paul/.agents/skills, /Users/paul/.claude/skills
> /framer
- Connect to your projects
In your AI agent, run the /framer skill to connect it to your Framer project and grant access to the project from your browser. This establishes the connection between your external AI and your Framer project.
⏺ Bash (npx @framer/agent setup)\ Installed 2 skills to /Users/paul/.agents/skills, /Users/paul/.claude/skills
Connected to your Site project (session 6). What would you like me to help you with?
> List all the blogposts in my project
- Write your first prompt
Tell your agent what to build, change, or fix. It works directly in your Framer project without the need to have it open. This means you can update anything in your project and even publish remotely.
